name: External Message Function 1 Code
definition: Code to identify the type of process related to the message, as published separately in a message function external code set.||External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

ADVC.name: Advice
ADVC.definition: Advice indicates where the sender informs the receiver of an activity that has been taken that requires a response.

CAAD.name: Capture Advice
CAAD.definition: Advice about the capture of an activity already performed (response expected).

CANO.name: Capture Notification
CANO.definition: Notification about the capture of an activity already performed (no response expected).

BNTF.name: Batch Notification
BNTF.definition: Notification to initiate the transfer of a batch (no response expected).

BTRQ.name: Batch Request
BTRQ.definition: Request to initiate the transfer of a batch (response expected).

CLNF.name: Collection Notification
CLNF.definition: Notification to initiate the transfer of a collection (no response expected).

CLRQ.name: Collection Request
CLRQ.definition: Request to initiate the transfer of a collection (response expected).

STAD.name: Status Advice
STAD.definition: Advice about the status of a transaction.

STNO.name: Status Notification
STNO.definition: Notification about the status of a transaction.

ERNO.name: Error Notification
ERNO.definition: Notification of a message containing errors.

INSN.name: Instruction
INSN.definition: Informs of an action to be taken.
